Body.Content:
The Azure Sphere 22.02 feature release is now available and includes the following components:

  • Updated Azure Sphere OS
  • Updated Azure Sphere SDK for Windows and for Linux
  • Updated Azure Sphere extensions for Visual Studio and for Visual Studio Code
  • Updated samples and tutorials

If your devices are connected to the internet, they will receive the updated OS from the cloud. You'll be prompted to install the updated SDK on next use.

Learn more about the features and enhancements included in this release by visiting What’s new in Azure Sphere in our customer documentation.

For information on support options available or to provide product feedback, visit the Support page.
